title: The Reverse Gravity Room
hook: For 1 year, gravity is inverted for you whenever you step indoors. Do you take $20,000,000?
scenario: A wealthy eccentric researcher offers you $20,000,000 cash on the spot. The catch: for exactly 365 days, gravity is reversed only for your body the instant you step under any ceiling or roof (you will fall upward to the ceiling at 9.8 m/s² unless strapped down). Outdoors, gravity remains normal.

choices.label: Accept the $20M Inversion Contract
choices.description: Take the fortune, wear padded helmets, and customize your home ceilings with velcro and nets.
choices.tradeOff: Every doorway is a concussion hazard; you cannot visit stores, restaurants, or friends' houses normally.

choices.label: Decline the Eccentric Offer
choices.description: Walk away with zero dollars and keep your normal, right-side-up life.
choices.tradeOff: You forfeit $20,000,000 of pure generational wealth over 12 months of temporary absurdity.

pollQuestion: Do you take the $20M and live on the ceiling for a year?

payoff.reveal: With $20M, you can hire contractors to turn an estate into a custom inverted luxury palace within 3 days, making the challenge easy.
payoff.surprisingOutcome: Over 85% of people enthusiastically accept when they realize outdoor living and customized ceilings solve 95% of the danger.
payoff.communityTension: Absurd daily inconvenience vs. life-changing wealth.
payoff.strategicAnalysis: Capital transforms physical constraints into solvable engineering problems.
